description: A Dec 23 report describes an August-start encampment and clearance of around 42 people, below 50 in the reported cleared group. The event began before December; other earlier attendance and continuity are unknown. Its relation to the separate July-start INDERT group reported in October is unresolved. A second outlet reports 48 people (42 from Caazapá and 6 from Canindeyú), whereas Última Hora reports around 42; both describe an August-start continuation and police reopening the road. The discrepancy and relation to the July-start October camp remain unresolved.
required_followup: Compare report timestamps/definitions and earlier records to assess same-group identity; do not average counts or assign an exact date from the duration phrase.
